resources.string: Search and browse your Google Photos from SAO. This experimental source uses Google’s private interfaces.

Enable SAO Google Photos in Vector (modern LSPosed), select Google Photos in its scope, then force-stop and reopen Google Photos. Connect below and choose your account. Expired sessions renew silently when you use this source, while Google allows it. Google may still require you to reconnect.
All media enables search. Album sources browse that album in its saved order; account-wide search is kept separate.
Context sends your full query, including emoji, to Google Photos. OCR uses Google’s quoted Text matches: it can also match captions and filenames. Google does not expose an OCR-only switch here.

If native connection is unavailable, import a Google Photos cookies.txt export or paste its Cookie header. Keep this account credential private. It is encrypted on this device; SAO receives only media and the source name.
For imported sessions only: 0 for the first account, 1 for /u/1/, and so on.
